title: Complete an appointment's clinical session
summary: Record the procedure, diagnosis, notes and plan for the next session; when saved, the appointment becomes completed.

steps.title: Menu → My Workspace
steps.details: The doctor's view: their schedule and the clinical panel of the patient they're seeing.

steps.title: Choose the patient's appointment
steps.details: Tap the appointment on the schedule: the patient panel opens on the right. If you don't see appointments, change the day or the period at the top.

steps.title: Complete clinical session
steps.details: If the button is disabled: there's already a session today, the appointment is on another day or the session is an odontogram one (it's edited from Odontogram).

steps.title: Procedure
steps.details: What was done today. You can dictate it; the quote's treatments show as tags to check.

steps.title: Next session plan
steps.details: What's due next time: it stays as context when the next appointment is booked.

steps.title: Treatments
steps.details: The quote's treatments: check the ones performed today.

steps.title: Attachments
steps.details: Photos, X-rays or documents from this session.

steps.title: Discharge
steps.details: If the treatment is over, marks the patient as discharged.

steps.title: Save the session
steps.details: When saved, the appointment becomes Completed.
